description: This file defines the CoalescingFSEventsWatcher class, which encapsulates macOS File System Events to monitor changes in specified paths with coalescing behavior to handle rapid successive events.

classes.name: CoalescingFSEventsWatcher
classes.description: A class that watches for file system events on specified paths, with coalescing of rapid changes to reduce event handling overhead.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the watcher with paths, dispatch queue label, coalescing delay, notification condition, and change callback.

methods.name: deinit
methods.description: Stops the watcher and releases resources upon deallocation.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the file system event stream to begin monitoring.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the monitoring stream and releases associated resources.

methods.name: handleEvents
methods.description: Handles incoming batch of file system events, applying coalescing logic before invoking the callback.
